quote_text: A leader is a dealer in hope.
The battlefield is a scene of constant chaos. The winner will be the one who controls that chaos, both his own and the enemy's.
A great leader never sets out to be a leader. He sets out to make a difference.
The measure of a man is what he does with power.
Wise men speak because they have something to say; fools because they have to say something.
Optimism is true moral courage.

author_bio: 26th President of the United States and conservationist
quote_text: The best executive is one who has sense enough to pick good men to do what he wants done, and self-restraint to keep from meddling while they do it.
Take time to deliberate, but when the time for action comes, stop thinking and go in.
He who is everywhere is nowhere.
Better a little which is well done, than a great deal imperfectly.
One never notices what has been done; one can only see what remains to be done.
Concentrate every minute on doing what's in front of you with precise and genuine seriousness.
Everything we hear is an opinion, not a fact. Everything we see is a perspective, not the truth.
Impossible is a word to be found only in the dictionary of fools.
It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
Life is not easy for any of us. But what of that? We must have perseverance and above all confidence in ourselves.

author_bio: 26th President of the United States and conservationist
quote_text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
A leader is best when people barely know he exists.
Victorious warriors win first and then go to war.
Nearly all men can stand adversity, but if you want to test a man's character, give him power.
Courage is rightly esteemed the first of human qualities because it is the quality which guarantees all others.

author_bio: American general and 34th President of the United States
quote_text: You do not lead by hitting people over the head. That is assault, not leadership.
Lead me, follow me, or get out of my way.
Leadership and learning are indispensable to each other.
What you leave behind is not what is engraved in stone monuments, but what is woven into the lives of others.
The welfare of the people is the supreme law.
The heaviest penalty for declining to rule is to be ruled by someone inferior to yourself.
A soldier will fight long and hard for a bit of colored ribbon.
Through endurance we conquer.

author_bio: 26th President of the United States and conservationist
quote_text: Far better it is to dare mighty things than to rank with those poor spirits who neither enjoy much nor suffer much.
Well done is better than well said.
Character is destiny.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Do every act of your life as though it were the very last act.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
Lost time is never found again.
Dost thou love life? Then do not squander time, for that is the stuff life is made of.
He who knows others is wise. He who knows himself is enlightened.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
He will win who knows when to fight and when not to fight.
The beginning is the most important part of the work.
Be less curious about people and more curious about ideas.
It's not that I'm so smart, it's just that I stay with problems longer.
Opportunity is missed by most people because it is dressed in overalls and looks like work.
Finish each day and be done with it.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
You cannot step twice into the same river.
No man is free who cannot control himself.
The reason I beat the Austrians is that they did not know the value of five minutes.
Difficulties are just things to overcome, after all.
Our characters are the result of our conduct.
It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
No great thing is created suddenly.
Genius is 1% inspiration and 99% perspiration.
Whether you think you can, or you think you can't – you're right.
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
Do the thing and you will have the power.
An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
Imagination is more important than knowledge.
Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving.
If you are going through hell, keep going.
Slow and steady wins the race.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive, to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love.
Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood. Now is the time to understand more, so that we may fear less.
Victory belongs to the most persevering.
True happiness is to enjoy the present, without anxious dependence upon the future.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
He who cannot be a good follower cannot be a good leader.
